versions.localizedDescription:
## Welcome to OpenParsec v2.0.0!

This is the release promised back in 1.4.0, with everything that's been on the nightly since october.

We now have a Metal renderer, streams that hold and reconnect by themselves, new connecting screens,reworked settings, and other control-related improvements.

---

Before you update:
- auto reconnect is now switched on by default, see settings > developer for additional settings
- everyone is now on the new Metal renderer. OpenGL is remains optional as a fallback\
- this is the last release for ios 14. it runs with some rough edges but remains functional. Future releases will be pinned, and we plan to require ios 15 starting from the next release. A seperate branch for iOS 14 will be created for backporting fixes as maintainer time allows

streaming
- metal renderer, now the default (#118)
- 120hz on ProMotion iphones (#118)
- the stream stays connected in the background for as long as ios allows, and reconnects when you're back (#138)
- the last frame stays up when the stream drops (#138)
- auto reconnect waits for the network to come back, and reconnects right away on a wifi/cellular switch (#138)
- resolution, bitrate and constant frame rate survive a reconnect (#119)

input
- smoother trackpad scrolling, thanks @alantangok (#97)
- reverse scrolling works for trackpad and mouse, thanks @MoustacheOff (#116)
- menu edge swipe setting, thanks @alantangok (#100)
- left edge swipe brings back a hidden menu button (#120)
- show menu button off no longer hides the keyboard button (#120)
- mouse side buttons (#120)
- drag handle in direct mode when the keyboard covers the picture, three finger tap hides the keyboard (#120)
- the next controller takes over when the active one disconnects (#120)

app
- settings rework, and settings open from the stream menu (#119, #129)
- bitrate, constant frame rate and pinch to zoom are settings that carry over between streams (#119)
- touch mode in the stream menu (#129)
- connecting and reconnect screens match and show a live connection log (#130)
- says right away when there's no network, retries once if the host doesn't answer (#117)
- last host card stays after a disconnect, reconnect from the app icon (#117)
- host list refresh no longer blocks the screen, long press a host to copy its name (#113)
- new readme, contributing guide and issue templates (#139)

Thanks to everyone for making bug reports on nightly builds, and thank you for your support!

---
